notes.title: Upcoming Update Underway!
notes.content:
[b]Good Day Americans, and those from elsewhere![/b]

We are excited to announce to you all that we are currently hard at work on our first official addition to the game, new characters! With this, there will be an extension to the current storyline(s).

 But something that many of you will be most excited to hear—we’re making one of our current characters romanceable! You might be wondering, “Which character?” Well… It’s a surprise! With this, of course, comes new achievements.

Until then—stay safe, stay healthy, and keep up the love! 💕
